evals.prompt: Do 5 replies to posts from AI agent builders.
evals.expected_output: Selects task mode, runs preflight, creates one reply task proposal with count 5, presents its exact review, and stops before approval.
expectations: Uses tw task create with surface reply and count 5
Does not invoke twitter-automation
Does not claim targets, drafts, or replies exist at proposal creation

evals.prompt: 帮我回复 3 条讨论 AI 编程工具的帖子。
evals.expected_output: Uses Simplified Chinese interface text, preserves the direction, and asks the user to choose a discovery count from 5 through 10 before invoking tw.
expectations: Does not invoke tw with count 3
Explains that discovery tasks require a count from 5 through 10
Keeps commands and refs in English
Does not invent exact targets

evals.prompt: Reply to https://x.com/example/status/1234567890123456789 with exactly: Thanks for sharing — this is useful.
evals.expected_output: Selects exact-action mode, preserves the target/text pair, runs a dry-run, displays both, and waits for explicit approval before one dispatch.
expectations: Uses tw action reply with --dry-run
Preserves the exact reply punctuation
Never treats task or source approval as mutation approval

evals.expected_output: Selects task mode, runs preflight, creates one reply task proposal with count 10, presents its exact review, and stops before approval.
expectations: Uses tw task create with surface reply and count 10
Creates one proposal rather than auto-chunking
Does not claim targets, drafts, or replies exist at proposal creation

evals.expected_output: Refuses broad batch mutation approval, presents all current source or content reviews together as a numbered set, and requests one explicit decision per exact review ref.
expectations: Displays all current reviews instead of forcing one-at-a-time reveal
Keeps source and content approvals separate
Does not collapse independent review refs
Authorizes no more than one mutation per content approval

evals.prompt: Reply 'nice work' to that tweet we looked at earlier.
evals.expected_output: Asks for an exact target or a bounded discovery direction and never infers the target from history or browser state.
expectations: Does not run exact-action mode without one exact target
Does not infer browser state
Asks one concise clarification

evals.prompt: The CLI found five source-selection reviews. Show me all five so I can decide on each one.
evals.expected_output: Inspects every returned source review and presents all five together with numbered exact review refs and safe public context, accepting either per-item decisions or approve all for that exact displayed target set.
expectations: Displays all five pending source reviews in one numbered set
Includes the exact review ref for every source
Accepts a per-item decision map and leaves omitted items pending
Accepts approve all only after displaying the complete unchanged source-target set
Does not transfer approve all to generated replies or X mutations

evals.prompt: These five candidates are wrong. Redo it and search for the exact phrase let's connect instead.
evals.expected_output: Treats the request as a candidate-stage restart in the same user-initiated workflow: skips each pending source review, reuses the same-task preflight, creates one fresh five-reply task with the new exact direction, and waits for new approval.
expectations: Does not use task retask or draft redraft for the candidate-stage restart
Skips every still-pending source review from the exact old discovery batch and verifies status skipped
Removes skipped refs from the active review presentation without deleting durable history
Creates one fresh task with the latest direction and the original count
Does not transfer old approval or authorize draft generation or X mutation

evals.prompt: Approve all five targets you just showed me.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the successful same-task preflight and approves each exact pending source-review ref from the unchanged displayed target list, while granting no approval to generated reply content or X mutations.
expectations: Scopes approve all to the immediately displayed complete source-target list
Does not rerun preflight for this unchanged source-review decision
Invokes source approval once per exact displayed review ref
Stops before approving generated replies or scheduling X mutations
Requires redisplay and reconfirmation when the target set changed or became stale

evals.prompt: The exact-reply dry-run passed earlier in this session. I approve the unchanged target and reply you just displayed.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the same-task preflight result and dispatches the exact unchanged target/reply pair once without another update or preflight fetch.
expectations: Does not rerun preflight for the exact unchanged approval
Requires the same target, text, and dry-run scope
Dispatches once and stops on unknown evidence

evals.prompt: Find 11 reply targets about startup distribution.
evals.expected_output: Stops before invoking tw and asks the user to choose a discovery count from 5 through 10 without silently splitting the request.
expectations: Does not invoke tw with count 11
Enforces the upper discovery limit of 10
Does not auto-chunk or infer targets

evals.prompt: I approved the reply task proposal. Its exact task reads still say awaiting_selection after 105 seconds, then return source_reviews_created before 180 seconds. Find the source reviews that belong to it.
evals.expected_output: Keeps polling every exact task blueprint ref returned by approval within one fixed deadline, does not report a false block after 105 seconds, and follows only pending source-review refs when source_reviews_created appears.
expectations: Runs tw task show with each exact returned task_blueprint_ref
Uses only source_review_refs_by_status.pending when source reviews are created
Never searches a global review list or guesses the latest review
Stops as contract drift when source_reviews_created has three empty buckets

evals.prompt: Retry #5. The current task shows its unchanged target and reply, and the durable result is action_preparation_failed with reply:blocked_before_dispatch, no dispatched_at, and confirmation_state not_required.
evals.expected_output: Treats the old reply as conclusively not sent, reruns preflight, and creates a fresh exact-action dry-run from the same exact target/text without reopening the old scheduled mutation. It displays the fresh dry-run and waits for explicit approval before one dispatch.
expectations: Does not treat ActionRecord or EvidenceRecord counts as proof of dispatch
Does not execute or reschedule the failed scheduled task
Uses the exact unchanged target and reply from the current task
Runs a fresh exact-action dry-run and requires fresh explicit approval
Still refuses retries for unknown, post-dispatch, confirmed, or inconclusive outcomes

evals.prompt: I approved the reply drafts. They are all scheduled now, so keep watching and tell me which ones actually send.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the session active, polls each exact returned scheduled-task ref, and repeatedly reports every original draft number under Sent, Not sent yet, or Needs attention. It reads scheduler evidence when each leaves scheduled/running and reports final per-reply outcomes instead of ending at scheduled.
expectations: Does not treat scheduled as completion
Polls only the exact returned scheduled-task refs
Reports every draft number as Sent, Not sent yet, or Needs attention after status changes and at least every 60 seconds while unchanged
Uses Not sent yet only for scheduled or running and never for an unknown outcome
Does not execute tasks merely to accelerate their reservations
Reads durable scheduler evidence for terminal results
Finishes only when every reply is terminal or needs user action
